name: NYC-311
project_purpose: Improve understanding of city service demand and support more efficient resource allocation.
primary_task_target: Three resolution-time classes for Brooklyn heat complaints
analytical_task: Describe request patterns, classify resolution-time ranges, forecast daily volumes, and compare storm-related response times.

name: Crash Modeling
project_purpose: Support safer roads by identifying high-risk locations and factors associated with elevated crash risk.
primary_task_target: Any crash on a segment in week 19 of 2017
analytical_task: Estimate and map crash risk for each road segment using historical and segment-level features.

name: Chelsea Housing and Public Health
project_purpose: Help Chelsea identify housing-related public-health risks earlier and prioritize limited inspection capacity.
analytical_task: Classify properties by their likelihood of having specified housing-code violations.
